# Simple, single and nested constructor matches

Five originals are byte-for-byte Apache-2.0 copies of pinned Bend
`e6676b080f25b1bc1bf5b5b7d7a17e22f8022599` tests/flatten: simple_ctor_000,
simple_ctor_001, single_ctor_type_001, single_ctor_type_001_mk and nested_literal.
Oracle-derived normal forms, graphs and refusal text retain that attribution.
New adapters, wrappers and tests use MPL-2.0.

Original builds require Base; separate applicability adapters reach function
printer refusal. The bounded grid has 33 inputs: 4 simple Nat, 5 optional Nat,
4 single-constructor matches, 4 constructor-building applications and 16 nested
Env combinations. Complete original values/graphs are compared separately from
scalar projections. `values/` returns full imported constructors; generated
upstream-JS printer timeouts remain unresolved rather than counting projection
agreement as exact constructor-output parity.
